reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adapts Windows shell environments by generating minimal-mode agent presets for pwsh, Git Bash, and WSL2, with restoration on uninstall.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上生成适配 pwsh、Git Bash 和 WSL2 的极简模式智能体预设，并在卸载时恢复配置。
summaries.en: Generates minimal-mode agent presets for DeepSeek Harness on Windows with pwsh, Git Bash, and WSL2 support, and restores the configuration on uninstall.

capabilities: Generates minimal-mode agent presets for Windows environments using pwsh, Git Bash, and WSL2
Adapts DeepSeek Harness configuration and restores it when uninstalled
